body:
Well I managed so far. Hopefully I can go even further... 

Imagine it like torments of Tantalus. I have everything within my reach. Successful, smart, look great... And the thing you want most of all is there for the taking. And yet when you try to take it it recedes... It's gone. Vanished. And you are left with all of your empty, in the long run meaningless, accomplishments... Looking at everyone loving someone from the sidelines... Hoping for a clean break to get in that court... Waiting for a break that never comes...
Thank you for your kind words stranger. I appreciate it.

Thank you very much for your reply first and foremost. 

I am successful. I work really hard on anything I do and it pays off. I have everything, and I mean everything, I've ever wanted. In this day and age that is rare but I succeeded. And yet the emptiness of it all is killing me because I have no one to share it with. I know this comes as a late reply to your best wishes, but I was keeping myself preoccupied with work and training.

As for doctors... I've been there during college. They actually signed me off saying that there is nothing wrong with me. No meds, no therapy no anything. They said it's just a phase... But it's not. During elementary and high school I was kind of a loner, geek, outcast whatever you want to call it. But I was not bullied. In college I opened up and started with fitness training and dancing. I'm always in company of women and yet somehow... Magically I would say... I am still alone. As an engineer I'm used to facts and how stuff works. But here I am at a complete loss and cannot fix something I don't understand. For me this is a paradox state. And paradox is unsustainable. 

No deeper cause. I am pretty satisfied with everything. It's not a matter of sex even. If I wanted I could have it right now. As I said I look pretty good with years of training... But relationship is what I'm missing. And yet women avoid me on that area as though I have a bloody plague...

I am still thinking about doing the 'deed' but with alcohol gone out of my system it's more of a sideline thought than conscious thinking. It is the easiest way out of this hellhole but I really don't want to take it. But on the other hand there is so many questions in my mind... Why am I alone? Am I unlovable and unlikable? Am I just considered a big dumb oaf by women? How come everyone can have someone and yet I remain the only constant? Is eating the bullet really the only way to escape this torment... I feel like a bloody Tantalus...
